maddeler.e:
نستقيل (form X)
# نَسْتَقِيلُ (nastaqīlu) /nas.ta.qiː.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقَالَ (istaqāla)
# نَسْتَقِيلَ (nastaqīla) /nas.ta.qiː.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقَالَ (istaqāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
